en.t: She handed it to the messenger to take back.

units.source_text: 她想叫薰大将也知道她赴死的决心。

en.t: She wanted General Kaoru to know as well of her resolve to go to her death.

units.source_text: 但她又想：“我对双方都写信通知，

en.t: But then she thought, "If I write to both sides and let them know,

units.source_text: 他们原是亲密朋友，终于会互相说出，此事亦甚乏味。

en.t: since they have long been close friends, they will eventually tell each other, and that would be terribly tiresome.

units.source_text: 我将使任何人都不明我的去向，谁也不知我之所终。”

en.t: I will make sure no one knows where I have gone, and no one knows what became of me."
So she decided not to tell General Kaoru.
